module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Proportional by Balance (PBB): 3 Accounts with Equal Balances
precondition: Master opens 3.00 lots EURUSD; 3 sub-accounts hold $10k, $10k, $10k (Total $30k).
steps: 1. Allocation engine applies formula: Child_Lots = Master_Lots * (Account_Balance / Total_Balance).
expected: Each sub-account receives exactly 1.00 lot (3.00 * $10k / $30k); sum of child lots == 3.00 lots.
coverage_note: Current MAM uses follower/master balance ratios. Original conserved block allocation across subaccounts is a different sizing model.
